```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(42)

comparison_colors <- c("maxEE22" = "#0072B2", "maxEE88" = "#D55E00")
results_dir <- file.path("Results", "01_ITSxpress_maxEE22_vs_maxEE88")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

theme_set(
  theme_bw(base_family = "Noto Sans CJK KR", base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey70"),

datatable_basic <- function(x, page_length = 10) {
  DT::datatable(
    x,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "none",
    extensions = character(0),
    options = list(dom = "tp", pageLength = page_length, autoWidth = TRUE)
  )
}

q2_metadata <- readr::read_tsv(
  "benchmark_results/q20_ee22_both_full/downstream/cutadapt_paired/metadata.qiime.tsv",
  skip = 2,
  col_names = c(
    "SampleID", "No", "Subject", "Direction", "Region", "Cycle_1st",
    "Cycle_2nd", "PCR1_Group", "PCR2_Group", "PCR_Cycle_Group",
    "Qubit_ng_uL", "bp", "Mol_Conc_nM", "Normalized"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    Sample_Type = case_when(
      str_detect(Subject, regex("mock|zymo", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Mock",
      str_detect(Subject, regex("^(ASwab|CSwab|ETube)", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Control",
      TRUE ~ "True"
    ),
    Control_Type = case_when(
      str_detect(Subject, regex("^ASwab", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Air swab",
      str_detect(Subject, regex("^CSwab", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Clean bench swab",
      str_detect(Subject, regex("^ETube", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Empty tube",
      Sample_Type == "Mock" ~ "Mock",
      TRUE ~ "Skin sample"
    ),
    Skin_Site = case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" & (is.na(Direction) | Direction %in% c("", "-")) ~ as.character(Region),
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ paste(Region, Direction),
      TRUE ~ Control_Type
    ),
    Shape_Group = case_when(
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ Control_Type,
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ Subject,
      TRUE ~ "Mock"
    ),
    PCR_Cycle_Group = factor(
      PCR_Cycle_Group,
      levels = c(
        "PCR1_33__PCR2_8", "PCR1_33__PCR2_10",
        "PCR1_35__PCR2_8", "PCR1_35__PCR2_10"
      )
    )
  )

phy_22 <- readRDS("Phyloseq/phy_ITS2_itsxpress_q20_ee22_20261015.rds")
phy_88 <- readRDS("Phyloseq/phy_ITS2_itsxpress_q20_ee88_20261015.rds")

common_samples <- intersect(sample_names(phy_22), sample_names(phy_88))
phy_22_common <- prune_samples(common_samples, phy_22)
phy_88_common <- prune_samples(common_samples, phy_88)

otu_matrix <- function(ps) {
  x <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) x <- t(x)
  x
}

species_matrix <- function(ps) {
  otu <- otu_matrix(ps)
  tax <- data.frame(tax_table(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  label <- as.character(tax$Species)
  label[is.na(label) | label == ""] <- "Unclassified_fungi"
  label <- str_replace_all(label, "_", " ")
  rowsum(otu, group = label, reorder = FALSE)
}

taxon_palette <- c(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")
)
```

# 1. Dataset 및 object 차이

- ITSxpress와 QC20을 고정하고 DADA2 maxEE 2/2와 8/8만 비교함.
- abundance filtering, singleton removal, rarefaction 및 decontam은 적용하지 않음.
- 각 object의 실제 fungal sample과 ASV를 먼저 확인하고, paired 통계와 beta diversity는 두 object에 공통으로 존재하는 SampleID만 사용함.

```{r object-summary}
object_summary <- tibble(
  maxEE = c("maxEE22", "maxEE88"),
  Samples = c(nsamples(phy_22), nsamples(phy_88)),
  Fungal_ASVs = c(ntaxa(phy_22), ntaxa(phy_88)),
  Total_Fungal_Reads = c(sum(sample_sums(phy_22)), sum(sample_sums(phy_88))),
  Method_Only_Samples = c(
    length(setdiff(sample_names(phy_22), sample_names(phy_88))),
    length(setdiff(sample_names(phy_88), sample_names(phy_22)))
  ),
  Common_Samples = length(common_samples)
)

datatable_basic(object_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Total_Fungal_Reads", 0)

write_csv(object_summary, file.path(results_dir, "00_object_summary.csv"))
```

# 2. Sample별 read 및 observed ASV

```{r sample-qc}
sample_qc <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    SampleID = sample_names(phy_22_common),
    maxEE = "maxEE22",
    Read_Depth = as.numeric(sample_sums(phy_22_common)),
    Observed_ASV = as.integer(estimate_richness(phy_22_common, measures = "Observed")$Observed)
  ),
  tibble(
    SampleID = sample_names(phy_88_common),
    maxEE = "maxEE88",
    Read_Depth = as.numeric(sample_sums(phy_88_common)),
    Observed_ASV = as.integer(estimate_richness(phy_88_common, measures = "Observed")$Observed)
  )
) |>
  left_join(q2_metadata, by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(maxEE = factor(maxEE, levels = c("maxEE22", "maxEE88")))

sample_qc_wide <- sample_qc |>
  select(SampleID, maxEE, Read_Depth, Observed_ASV) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = maxEE, values_from = c(Read_Depth, Observed_ASV))

paired_qc <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Read depth", "Observed ASV"),
  N_Pairs = nrow(sample_qc_wide),
  Median_maxEE22 = c(
    median(sample_qc_wide$Read_Depth_maxEE22),
    median(sample_qc_wide$Observed_ASV_maxEE22)
  ),
  Median_maxEE88 = c(
    median(sample_qc_wide$Read_Depth_maxEE88),
    median(sample_qc_wide$Observed_ASV_maxEE88)
  ),
  P_value = c(
    wilcox.test(sample_qc_wide$Read_Depth_maxEE88, sample_qc_wide$Read_Depth_maxEE22,
                paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(sample_qc_wide$Observed_ASV_maxEE88, sample_qc_wide$Observed_ASV_maxEE22,
                paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value
  )
) |>
  mutate(P_adjust_BH = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"))

datatable_basic(paired_qc, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Median_maxEE22", "Median_maxEE88"), 1) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)

write_csv(paired_qc, file.path(results_dir, "01a_paired_sample_QC_tests.csv"))
```

# 3. Exact ASV sequence 및 taxonomy 안정성

```{r asv-sequence-data}
seq_22 <- getElement(read_qza(
  "benchmark_results/q20_ee22_both_full/dada2/itsxpress/paired/repseq.qza"
), "data")
seq_88 <- getElement(read_qza(
  "benchmark_results/q20_ee88_both_full/dada2/itsxpress/paired/repseq.qza"
), "data")

otu_22 <- otu_matrix(phy_22)
otu_88 <- otu_matrix(phy_88)
tax_22 <- data.frame(tax_table(phy_22), check.names = FALSE) |>
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")
tax_88 <- data.frame(tax_table(phy_88), check.names = FALSE) |>
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

asv_22 <- tibble(
  FeatureID_22 = rownames(otu_22),
  Sequence = as.character(seq_22[rownames(otu_22)]),
  Length_22 = width(seq_22[rownames(otu_22)]),
  Reads_22 = rowSums(otu_22),
  Prevalence_22 = rowSums(otu_22 > 0)
) |>
  left_join(tax_22 |> rename(FeatureID_22 = FeatureID), by = "FeatureID_22")

asv_88 <- tibble(
  FeatureID_88 = rownames(otu_88),
  Sequence = as.character(seq_88[rownames(otu_88)]),
  Length_88 = width(seq_88[rownames(otu_88)]),
  Reads_88 = rowSums(otu_88),
  Prevalence_88 = rowSums(otu_88 > 0)
) |>
  left_join(tax_88 |> rename(FeatureID_88 = FeatureID), by = "FeatureID_88")

shared_asv <- inner_join(asv_22, asv_88, by = "Sequence", suffix = c("_22", "_88")) |>
  mutate(
    Frequency_22 = Reads_22 / sum(otu_22),
    Frequency_88 = Reads_88 / sum(otu_88),
    Taxonomy_Identical =
      coalesce(Kingdom_22, "") == coalesce(Kingdom_88, "") &
      coalesce(Phylum_22, "") == coalesce(Phylum_88, "") &
      coalesce(Class_22, "") == coalesce(Class_88, "") &
      coalesce(Order_22, "") == coalesce(Order_88, "") &
      coalesce(Family_22, "") == coalesce(Family_88, "") &
      coalesce(Genus_22, "") == coalesce(Genus_88, "") &
      coalesce(Species_22, "") == coalesce(Species_88, "")
  )

unique_22 <- anti_join(asv_22, asv_88 |> select(Sequence), by = "Sequence") |>
  mutate(Status = "maxEE22 only")
unique_88 <- anti_join(asv_88, asv_22 |> select(Sequence), by = "Sequence") |>
  mutate(Status = "maxEE88 only")

sequence_overlap <- tibble(
  Item = c(
    "maxEE22 fungal ASVs", "maxEE88 fungal ASVs", "Exact shared ASVs",
    "maxEE22-only ASVs", "maxEE88-only ASVs",
    "maxEE22 reads in shared ASVs", "maxEE88 reads in shared ASVs",
    "Shared sequences with different cleaned taxonomy"
  ),
  N_or_fraction = c(
    nrow(asv_22), nrow(asv_88), nrow(shared_asv), nrow(unique_22), nrow(unique_88),
    sum(shared_asv$Reads_22) / sum(otu_22),
    sum(shared_asv$Reads_88) / sum(otu_88),
    sum(!shared_asv$Taxonomy_Identical)
  )
)

datatable_basic(sequence_overlap, 10) |>
  DT::formatSignif("N_or_fraction", 5)
```

```{r shared-asv-frequency-plot, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=7}
sequence_rho <- cor(shared_asv$Frequency_22, shared_asv$Frequency_88, method = "spearman")

shared_frequency_plot <- ggplot(shared_asv, aes(Frequency_22, Frequency_88)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey55") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.7, colour = comparison_colors[["maxEE88"]]) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_percent()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_percent()) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Exact shared ASV frequency (Spearman rho = ", round(sequence_rho, 3), ")"),
    x = "maxEE22 fraction of fungal reads",
    y = "maxEE88 fraction of fungal reads"
  )

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "02_exact_shared_ASV_frequency.png"), shared_frequency_plot,
       width = 8.5, height = 7, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
shared_frequency_plot
```

```{r unique-asv-tables}
unique_asv_summary <- bind_rows(
  unique_22 |>
    transmute(Status, FeatureID = FeatureID_22, Length = Length_22,
              Reads = Reads_22, Prevalence = Prevalence_22, Species),
  unique_88 |>
    transmute(Status, FeatureID = FeatureID_88, Length = Length_88,
              Reads = Reads_88, Prevalence = Prevalence_88, Species)
) |>
  mutate(Species = str_replace_all(Species, "_", " ")) |>
  arrange(Status, desc(Reads))

unique_asv_group_summary <- unique_asv_summary |>
  group_by(Status) |>
  summarise(
    N_ASV = n(),
    Total_Reads = sum(Reads),
    Median_Reads = median(Reads),
    Single_Sample_ASVs = sum(Prevalence == 1),
    Median_Length = median(Length),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

datatable_basic(unique_asv_group_summary, 10)
datatable_basic(unique_asv_summary |> group_by(Status) |> slice_max(Reads, n = 20) |> ungroup(), 20)

write_csv(sequence_overlap, file.path(results_dir, "02a_sequence_overlap_summary.csv"))
write_csv(shared_asv, file.path(results_dir, "02b_exact_shared_ASVs.csv"))
write_csv(unique_asv_summary, file.path(results_dir, "02c_condition_specific_ASVs.csv"))
```

# 4. Species 검출 및 abundance 차이

```{r species-data}
species_22 <- species_matrix(phy_22_common)
species_88 <- species_matrix(phy_88_common)
all_species <- union(rownames(species_22), rownames(species_88))

align_species <- function(x) {
  out <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_species), ncol = length(common_samples),
                dimnames = list(all_species, common_samples))
  out[rownames(x), colnames(x)] <- x[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  out
}

species_22_aligned <- align_species(species_22)
species_88_aligned <- align_species(species_88)
rel_22 <- sweep(species_22_aligned, 2, colSums(species_22_aligned), "/")
rel_88 <- sweep(species_88_aligned, 2, colSums(species_88_aligned), "/")

species_comparison <- tibble(
  Species = all_species,
  Reads_maxEE22 = rowSums(species_22_aligned),
  Reads_maxEE88 = rowSums(species_88_aligned),
  Prevalence_maxEE22 = rowSums(species_22_aligned > 0),
  Prevalence_maxEE88 = rowSums(species_88_aligned > 0),
  Mean_maxEE22 = rowMeans(rel_22),
  Mean_maxEE88 = rowMeans(rel_88)
) |>
  mutate(
    Detection_Status = case_when(
      Reads_maxEE22 > 0 & Reads_maxEE88 > 0 ~ "Shared",
      Reads_maxEE22 > 0 ~ "maxEE22 only",
      TRUE ~ "maxEE88 only"
    ),
    Mean_Difference_88_minus_22 = Mean_maxEE88 - Mean_maxEE22,
    Combined_Mean = (Mean_maxEE22 + Mean_maxEE88) / 2
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Combined_Mean))

species_overlap <- species_comparison |>
  count(Detection_Status, name = "N_Species")

top_species <- species_comparison |>
  slice_head(n = 14) |>
  pull(Species)

paired_species <- lapply(top_species, function(sp) {
  x <- rel_22[sp, ]
  y <- rel_88[sp, ]
  tibble(
    Species = sp,
    N_Pairs = length(x),
    Mean_maxEE22 = mean(x),
    Mean_maxEE88 = mean(y),
    Mean_Difference_88_minus_22 = mean(y - x),
    P_value = if (all(x == y)) 1 else wilcox.test(y, x, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value
  )
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  mutate(
    P_adjust_BH = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = case_when(
      P_adjust_BH < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_adjust_BH < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_adjust_BH < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(P_adjust_BH)

datatable_basic(species_overlap, 10)
datatable_basic(paired_species, 14) |>
  DT::formatPercentage(c("Mean_maxEE22", "Mean_maxEE88", "Mean_Difference_88_minus_22"), 3) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)
```

```{r species-scatter, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
    ),

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "03_species_detection_and_abundance.png"), species_scatter,

species_scatter
```

# 5. Aitchison PCoA 및 paired maxEE effect

```{r beta-data}
clr_transform <- function(x, pseudocount = 0.5) {
  log_x <- log(t(x) + pseudocount)
  sweep(log_x, 1, rowMeans(log_x), "-")
}

clr_22 <- clr_transform(species_22_aligned)
clr_88 <- clr_transform(species_88_aligned)
rownames(clr_22) <- paste0("maxEE22__", rownames(clr_22))
rownames(clr_88) <- paste0("maxEE88__", rownames(clr_88))
combined_clr <- rbind(clr_22, clr_88)

pcoa_meta <- tibble(RowID = rownames(combined_clr)) |>
  separate(RowID, into = c("maxEE", "SampleID"), sep = "__", extra = "merge", remove = FALSE) |>
  left_join(q2_metadata |> select(SampleID, Shape_Group, PCR_Cycle_Group), by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    maxEE = factor(maxEE, levels = c("maxEE22", "maxEE88")),
    Shape_Group = factor(Shape_Group,
      levels = c("Air swab", "Clean bench swab", "Empty tube", "KSY", "PYH", "Mock"))
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("RowID")

aitchison_distance <- dist(combined_clr)
set.seed(42)
permanova <- adonis2(
  aitchison_distance ~ maxEE,
  data = pcoa_meta,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = pcoa_meta$SampleID
)
dispersion <- betadisper(aitchison_distance, pcoa_meta$maxEE)
set.seed(42)
dispersion_test <- permutest(dispersion, permutations = 999)

pcoa <- cmdscale(aitchison_distance, k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
pcoa_variance <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0] / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]) * 100
pcoa_score <- as_tibble(pcoa$points, rownames = "RowID") |>
  rename(Axis1 = V1, Axis2 = V2) |>
  left_join(rownames_to_column(pcoa_meta, "RowID"), by = "RowID")

ord_22 <- cmdscale(dist(clr_22), k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
ord_88 <- cmdscale(dist(clr_88), k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
set.seed(42)
procrustes_test <- protest(ord_22$points, ord_88$points, permutations = 999)

beta_summary <- tibble(
  Distance = "Aitchison (Species CLR, pseudocount 0.5)",
  N_Samples = length(common_samples),
  PERMANOVA_R2 = permanova$R2[1],
  PERMANOVA_P = permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1],
  Betadisper_P = dispersion_test$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1],
  Procrustes_Correlation = procrustes_test$t0,
  PROTEST_P = procrustes_test$signif
)

datatable_basic(beta_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("PERMANOVA_R2", "Procrustes_Correlation"), 4) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("PERMANOVA_P", "Betadisper_P", "PROTEST_P"), 3)

write_csv(beta_summary, file.path(results_dir, "04a_beta_summary.csv"))
```

```{r beta-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
main_pcoa <- ggplot(pcoa_score, aes(Axis1, Axis2, colour = maxEE, shape = Shape_Group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_line(aes(group = SampleID), colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.82) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = maxEE), linewidth = 0.7, linetype = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = comparison_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Air swab" = 0, "Clean bench swab" = 1, "Empty tube" = 2,
    "KSY" = 5, "PYH" = 6, "Mock" = 4
  ), drop = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "ITSxpress maxEE22 vs maxEE88 — paired Aitchison PCoA",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(pcoa_variance[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(pcoa_variance[2], 1), "%)"),
    colour = "maxEE", shape = "Control source / Skin subject"
  )

x_density <- axis_canvas(main_pcoa, axis = "x") +
  geom_density(data = pcoa_score, aes(x = Axis1, fill = maxEE, colour = maxEE),
               alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = comparison_colors)

y_density <- axis_canvas(main_pcoa, axis = "y", coord_flip = TRUE) +

pcoa_density_plot <- main_pcoa |>
  insert_xaxis_grob(x_density, grid::unit(0.75, "in"), position = "top") |>

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "04_aitchison_PCoA.png"), pcoa_density_plot,
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
```

# 6. SampleID별 Species composition

```{r composition-data}
top_composition_species <- species_comparison |>
  slice_head(n = 14) |>
  pull(Species)
composition_levels <- c(top_composition_species, "Others")
composition_colors <- setNames(taxon_palette[seq_along(composition_levels)], composition_levels)

relative_long <- function(x, maxee) {
  sweep(x, 2, colSums(x), "/") |>
    t() |>
    as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) |>
    rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
    pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "Species", values_to = "Relative_Abundance") |>
    mutate(maxEE = maxee)
}

composition_sample <- bind_rows(
  relative_long(species_22_aligned, "maxEE22"),
  relative_long(species_88_aligned, "maxEE88")
) |>
  left_join(q2_metadata |> select(SampleID, Sample_Type, Subject, Control_Type,
                                  Skin_Site, PCR_Cycle_Group), by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    Subject_Profile = case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ Subject,
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ Control_Type,
      TRUE ~ "Mock"
    ),
    Subject_Profile = factor(Subject_Profile,
      levels = c("Air swab", "Clean bench swab", "Empty tube", "KSY", "PYH", "Mock")),
    Species = if_else(Species %in% top_composition_species, Species, "Others"),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = rev(composition_levels))
  ) |>
  group_by(maxEE, SampleID, Subject_Profile, PCR_Cycle_Group, Species) |>
  summarise(Relative_Abundance = sum(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop")

sample_order <- q2_metadata |>
  mutate(Subject_Profile = case_when(
    Sample_Type == "True" ~ Subject,
    Sample_Type == "Control" ~ Control_Type,
    TRUE ~ "Mock"
  )) |>
  arrange(Subject_Profile, PCR_Cycle_Group, Skin_Site, SampleID) |>
  pull(SampleID)

composition_sample <- composition_sample |>
  mutate(SampleID = factor(SampleID, levels = sample_order))

draw_composition <- function(maxee) {
  ggplot(composition_sample |> filter(maxEE == maxee),
         aes(SampleID, Relative_Abundance, fill = Species)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(vars(Subject_Profile, PCR_Cycle_Group), scales = "free_x", nrow = 1, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = composition_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = paste0("ITSxpress ", maxee, " — sample-level Species composition"),
         x = "SampleID", y = "Relative abundance", fill = "Species") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6.5),
          legend.position = "right")
}

composition_22_plot <- draw_composition("maxEE22")
composition_88_plot <- draw_composition("maxEE88")

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "05a_species_composition_maxEE22.png"), composition_22_plot,
       width = 42, height = 8, dpi = 200, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "05b_species_composition_maxEE88.png"), composition_88_plot,
       width = 42, height = 8, dpi = 200, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
```

# 7. 결론

```{r conclusion, results='asis'}
cat(paste0(
  "- 두 ITSxpress object의 공통 sample은 ", length(common_samples), "개임.\n",
  "- fungal ASV는 maxEE22 ", ntaxa(phy_22), "개, maxEE88 ", ntaxa(phy_88), "개임.\n",
  "- exact shared ASV는 ", nrow(shared_asv), "개이며 maxEE22 reads의 ",
  percent(sum(shared_asv$Reads_22) / sum(otu_22), accuracy = 0.1),
  ", maxEE88 reads의 ", percent(sum(shared_asv$Reads_88) / sum(otu_88), accuracy = 0.1),
  "를 설명함.\n",
  "- 동일 sequence에서 cleaned taxonomy가 달라진 경우는 ",
  sum(!shared_asv$Taxonomy_Identical), "개임.\n",
  "- condition-specific Species는 maxEE22-only ",
  sum(species_comparison$Detection_Status == "maxEE22 only"), "개, maxEE88-only ",
  sum(species_comparison$Detection_Status == "maxEE88 only"), "개임.\n",
  "- maxEE88-only ASV ", nrow(unique_88), "개는 총 ", sum(unique_88$Reads_88),
  " reads이며 모두 단일 sample에서만 관찰됨. 이 ASV들이 추가한 새 Species label은 없음.\n",
  "- Aitchison PERMANOVA maxEE effect R2는 ", signif(beta_summary$PERMANOVA_R2, 3),
  ", p-value는 ", signif(beta_summary$PERMANOVA_P, 3),
  "임. p-value와 별개로 설명력은 사실상 0에 가까움.\n",
  "- Procrustes correlation은 ", signif(beta_summary$Procrustes_Correlation, 3),
  ", PROTEST p-value는 ", signif(beta_summary$PROTEST_P, 3), "임."
))
```

# 8. 해석 한계

- condition-specific ASV 또는 Species는 biological absence가 아니라 낮은 abundance, DADA2 error model 및 read retention 차이로 detection boundary를 넘나든 결과일 수 있음.
- 동일 sequence의 taxonomy가 일치하면 maxEE에 따른 분류기 자체의 변화가 아니라, 해당 sequence의 검출 여부가 달라진 것임.
- paired Wilcoxon은 maxEE parameter effect를 탐색하기 위한 분석이며 독립 biological group의 differential abundance 검정으로 해석하지 않음.
- Aitchison 분석은 rarefaction 없이 수행했으며 pseudocount 0.5를 사용함.
